reasoning_content:
Dienste-Tomcat deployed all five service WARs successfully. However, some of the web apps on anwendung and api failed to start. Let me check the actual errors:

- anwendung: xplan-validator-web and xplan-manager-web failed to start ("One or more listeners failed to start")
- api: xplan-manager-api and xplan-dokumente-api failed to deploy

Note the timestamps: the anwendung/api logs show 12:12, but the dienste logs show 10:12 — interestingly, the anwendung/api Tomcats were started with `-Duser.timezone=Europe/Berlin`, so they're showing local time (UTC+2 in October). The dienste Tomcat is on UTC. In other words, the times are consistent (10:12 UTC = 12:12 Berlin time).

Let's take a look at the specific errors.

action.command: grep -B2 -A20 "SEVERE.*One or more listeners failed" /opt/tomcat-anwendung/logs/catalina.out | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | grep -vE "^\s*$" | head -40
